name: Meeedly
description_en:
Meeedly is documented by its official blog as a meeting-scheduling and calendar-coordination service. It connects calendar availability, participant addresses and time-zone preferences to help identify a meeting slot. This is distinct from recording or transcribing a meeting.

The main site returned only a title during this research. Readable vendor-authored workflow articles therefore supply the product evidence, while live access, current price and contractual plan limits remain unverified.
description_zh:
Meeedly 官方博客将其描述为会议排期及日历协调服务，结合日历空闲、参与者地址和时区偏好寻找会议时段，与会议录制或转录不同。

本次主站只返回标题，因此产品证据来自可读厂商流程文章，实时访问、当前价格及合同套餐限制仍未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

sections.en: The vendor’s 2026 guide places Meeedly above existing Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace calendars, with organizational scheduling rules and cross-time-zone coordination. These are vendor-described capabilities, not an independently verified connector, privacy certification or operational guarantee. The articles do not establish that entering any arbitrary address grants access to a person’s calendar.
sections.zh: 厂商 2026 指南将 Meeedly 定位为现有 Microsoft 365 或 Google Workspace 日历之上的协调层，结合组织排期规则及跨时区协调。这些是厂商能力说明，并非独立验证的连接器、隐私认证或运营保证。文章没有证明输入任意地址就能取得对方日历权限。

sections.title_en: Example: find a shared review slot
sections.title_zh: 示例：寻找共同评审时段
sections.en: The dated workflow article describes signing in, connecting calendars, entering participant email addresses, examining available slots and creating a meeting from a selected slot. In an illustrative pilot, use two test accounts, a known busy block and the intended meeting duration. Confirm the invitation and each local time, then repeat with no shared availability and a changed event. This pilot was not executed.
sections.zh: 带日期流程文章介绍登录、连接日历、输入参与者邮箱、查看空闲时段，再按所选时段创建会议。试点可使用两个测试账户、已知忙碌区间及目标会议时长，核对邀请与各地时间，再检查没有共同空闲及事件变更。本例未实际运行。

sections.title_en: Calendar permissions and organizational rules come first
sections.title_zh: 先确认日历权限及组织规则
sections.en: Adoption depends on a permitted calendar connection and the participating organization’s access policy. Inventory which calendars are checked and who can create or change an invitation; inspect what another organization can actually see. A time-zone display is not evidence that every participant’s working hours or calendar is synchronized. Vendor claims of conflict elimination and time savings were not adopted as measured results.
sections.zh: 采用前提是获允许的日历连接及机构访问政策。应盘点检查哪些日历、谁能创建或修改邀请，并查看其他机构实际可见内容。时区显示不能证明所有参与者的工作时间或日历都同步，厂商消除冲突及节时宣传不当作实测结果。

sections.title_en: No verified current rate or permanent free tier
sections.title_zh: 未核实当前费率或持续免费版
sections.en: Older workflow text and navigation advertise free account creation, but no current plan matrix, billing unit, seat/calendar cap, renewal or ongoing free allowance was read. The Microsoft marketplace entry returned 403 and direct blog requests failed, while the public web reader returned the cited articles; no access restriction was bypassed. Leave price and free eligibility unknown. Deployment options, source licensing, retention, connector failures and live service continuity still need confirmation.
sections.zh: 旧流程及导航宣传免费创建账户，但未读取当前套餐表、计费单位、席位日历上限、续费或持续免费额度。Microsoft 商店条目返回 403，直接博客请求失败，公开网页阅读器返回了引用文章，未绕过访问限制。价格及免费资格保持未知；部署、源码许可、保留、连接器故障及服务连续性仍需确认。
